revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found and the core outcome read (booked, 6PM tomorrow, in-person) is solid and well-supported. However, Stage 3 has an internal consistency problem worth one targeted revision: it correctly raises serious diarization doubt about the 01:02 'rep' line (personal credit score / home purchase disclosure) and the 01:15 '670.' line, flagging both for manual audio review — but then it doesn't carry that same doubt into script_coverage (tax_credit_qualifier marked 'asked'/'completed' as if the rep cleanly asked and the customer cleanly answered) or into objections[0] (typed as a resolved 'cost' objection with a specific rep_attempts count and a rep quote for resolution). The rep's resolution quote used in objections[0] ('I just went up 53 points...') is structurally the same kind of personal-credit-history line Stage 3 flagged as likely mis-attributed one line earlier at 01:02 — this should either be flagged with the same caution or explicitly reasoned through (e.g., 'even if mis-attributed, the resolution content still functions as X'). Fix: (1) add a diarization-caution note to script_coverage's tax_credit_qualifier entry consistent with the caution already given in cherry_pick_moments, (2) either soften objections[0]'s confidence (resolved: true, rep_attempts: 1) with the same caveat, or explicitly justify why the objection-resolution framing survives the diarization doubt, (3) add the 00:48 'I don't really see anything here' line as supporting evidence for the recap-discipline coaching point in coaching_focus, since it directly evidences the customer's own uncertainty about deal continuity that the coaching point argues for.
